# Reboot Media

> Reboot Media builds and runs ads for roofing companies in the United States, so homeowners who need a roofer book straight onto the roofer's calendar. The roofer shows up and signs the job. We work with one roofer per service area.

## How it works

1. Audit: we review the company's online presence, keep what's working and remove what isn't.
2. Reboot: we set up ads in the company's own name and install a storm tracker that watches its area. Live in 2 business days.
3. Compound: the system learns which calls turn into signed jobs and puts more behind them every month.

Homeowners answer a few questions before they book, so the roofer knows what the job is before the inspection. It is not a shared-lead service: every homeowner who calls is calling that roofer. Pricing depends on the area and goals and is covered on a strategy call.

## Pages

- [Home and strategy call booking](https://rebootmedia.us/): what we do, who it's for, common questions, and the form to book a strategy call.
- [Free Visibility Check](https://rebootmedia.us/visibility-check): a free report, within one business day, showing which roofers homeowners in a city find first, where a company shows up, and the 3 fixes that would get it more calls.
- [Roofing Marketing Companies Compared (2026)](https://rebootmedia.us/roofing-marketing-companies): how 8 roofing marketing companies differ, based on each company's own website, and 5 questions to ask before signing with any of them.
